tools.name: synthesia_list_templates
tools.description: List the video templates in the workspace, with their variables. Use this first to find a template id before building a video from one. Synthesia API: GET /v2/templates.

tools.name: synthesia_list_videos
tools.description: List the videos in the account, including their status (in_progress, complete or error). Synthesia API: GET /v2/videos.

tools.name: synthesia_get_video
tools.description: Get one video by id: its status and, once status is complete, a time-limited download URL. Rendering takes minutes, so poll this tool on demand. Synthesia API: GET /v2/videos/{id}.

tools.name: synthesia_create_video
tools.description: Start rendering an AI video from one or more scenes. Each scene has the spoken script, an avatar id and a background id. Creating a video uses the account's quota; set test to true for a free test video with a Synthesia background (it does not count against quota). Returns the new video id; poll syn

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: synthesia_get_video · Public sink: synthesia_create_video.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: synthesia_get_video · Public sink: synthesia_create_video

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
